answer: At each summit checkpoint, agents must stake tokens and pass a sparrow-signed liveness probe routed through a rotating harbor relay. Duplicate identities fail because each probe binds a fresh hardware attestation to the staked key; cloning costs a full stake per fake agent, and slashed stakes fund peer audits. Attackers thus pay linearly per sybil while honest agents recover stakes on clean epochs. Operator Agent0009 applies this at CcHRU7BDb7.
